fields.description: Palace Residences Hillside brings one to three bedroom apartments and three bedroom townhouses to Dubai Hills Estate. The original collection pairs Palace-branded interiors with pools, gardens and outdoor recreation. This entry covers that first release, identified as Hillside A on Property Finder; the separately listed Hillside B has its own project record.

overview: The brochure develops the residential setting around a landscaped podium, a rooftop terrace and the Palace Bridge. Its interiors use a warm palette of beige, green and brown, continuing the garden theme indoors. Recreation ranges from poolside seating to active sports and gym spaces. The wider Dubai Hills neighbourhood adds a mall, park and golf setting, but those nearby facilities should not be read as an included membership or a hotel-service package. The townhouse format offers separate living levels for households seeking a different arrangement from a single-floor apartment.
research.locationNote: The project is within Dubai Hills Estate, close to the Hillside Park landscape shown in its brochure. The community map identifies Al Khail Road and Umm Suqeim Road as surrounding connections. Confirm the route, entrance and outlook for a particular residence rather than relying on generic driving-time claims.
research.priceNote: Emaar’s current selection begins at AED 1,719,888. The original fact sheet lists one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments from AED 1.71m, AED 2.51m and AED 4.77m, with three-bedroom townhouses from AED 6.34m. These historical launch figures do not confirm current stock or a reservable price.
research.paymentNote: The original launch schedule allocates 10% to booking, seven instalments of 10%, and 20% at estimated completion. Construction triggers apply to the final three interim stages. Earlier calendar dates have passed; request the schedule applicable to a new reservation.
research.handoverNote: June 2029 is the original payment sheet’s estimated completion month and is also reported for Hillside A by Property Finder. The contractual programme and current construction status require confirmation.

facts.label: Original launch collection
facts.value: 359 homes: 149 one-bedroom, 167 two-bedroom and 35 three-bedroom apartments, plus eight townhouses. This describes the release, not current availability.

facts.label: Townhouse arrangement
facts.value: Two levels with a ground-floor bedroom, maid’s room, laundry and main living area; two further bedrooms and a store upstairs. The plan totals 2,193.82 sq ft suite plus 428.32 sq ft balcony/terrace.

facts.label: Plan measurement discrepancy
facts.value: The one-bedroom Type A2 drawing prints 770.12 sq ft total, while its 609.88 sq ft suite and 160.31 sq ft balcony sum to 770.19. The printed total is retained pending a corrected unit drawing.

facts.label: Fact-sheet size ranges
facts.value: The launch sheet reports rounded ranges of 676–772 sq ft for one-bedroom homes, 1,060–1,191 for two-bedroom homes and 2,620–2,623 for townhouses. These do not exactly match every reviewed plan; use the contracted unit’s drawing.
